preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The length of the sequence is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each element in the sequence is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output is an integer representing the minimal value of the maximum value in the sequence after performing any number of bitwise AND operations on arbitrary intervals.
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal possible maximum value in the sequence after performing the described operations.
